description: This file defines the SpdyBuffer class used for managing data buffers in SPDY protocol connections, including callback mechanisms for data consumption and buffer management.

classes.name: SpdyBuffer
classes.description: A class to hold data read from or to be written to a SPDY connection, with callback support for data consumption.

methods.name: SpdyBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a SPDY serialized frame.

methods.name: SpdyBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a copy of raw data.

methods.name: AddConsumeCallback
methods.description: Adds a callback to be invoked when data is consumed.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Consumes a specified number of bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: GetRemainingData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the remaining unconsumed data.

methods.name: GetRemainingSize
methods.description: Returns the size of remaining unconsumed data.

methods.name: GetIOBufferForRemainingData
methods.description: Returns an IOBuffer pointing to the remaining data, usable even after consumption.
